findings.title: Native Save can discard text awaiting the next frame
findings.why_it_matters: Typing or pasting and invoking the native Save shortcut before the next display frame can save the preceding field value and then discard the latest input while reporting success. mygo queues editor changes until the view builds, but Window.Update runs this callback before requesting that build; save immediately snapshots the old Edit, and its completion replaces the editor state with the saved report. The existing view-level shortcut runs after the fields have consumed their queues, so routing native Save through that same point removes the ordering hazard.
findings.validation_reason: When text is queued before its requested frame, the new native Save callback at internal/desktop/desktop.go:134 reaches the edit snapshot at line 484 before third_party/mygo/ui/editor.go:812-819 updates the bound value, then completion at line 505 replaces that value; the caller's frozen-scope overlay reproduced the omitted title, while real-window incidence was not measured.
